definitions.explanation: Describes produce or farming methods that do not use chemical pesticides. Often used as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {無農薬|むのうやく}{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}っている。
この{農家|のうか}は{無農薬|むのうやく}で{米|こめ}を{栽培|さいばい}している。
examples.english: This farmer grows rice without pesticides.

examples.japanese: {無農薬|むのうやく}{栽培|さいばい}は{手間|てま}がかかるが、{安全性|あんぜんせい}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Pesticide-free farming takes more effort, but offers higher safety.

notes: Compound of {無|む} (without) + {農薬|のうやく} (agricultural chemicals/pesticides). Common collocations: {無農薬|むのうやく}{野菜|やさい} (pesticide-free vegetables), {無農薬|むのうやく}{栽培|さいばい} (pesticide-free cultivation). Note that {無農薬|むのうやく} specifically means no pesticides were used, which is narrower than {有機|ゆうき} (organic), which also covers fertilizers and other standards.
